name: Baby Jesus
overview: The birth of Baby Jesus is a divine fulfillment of prophecy, as Isaiah foretold a virgin would conceive and bear a son named Immanuel, meaning 'God with us.' This child, born in Bethlehem as Micah predicted, is given names that reveal His divine nature and mission, including Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, and Prince of Peace. Matthew's gospel confirms that Jesus was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born to save His people from their sins, emphasizing His role as Savior from the very beginning of His life.
